welcome.title: Welcome to TEN10
welcome.description: We'll show you how to get started in less than a minute.
welcome.skip: I'll look around on my own

tour.homeIntroDescription: Income, tithe, donations, and the remaining balance live here. We'll walk through the parts that matter, then add a transaction.
tour.dateRangeDescription: This month, this year, all time, or a custom range. Now that you know the cards, this is how you choose which period they show.
tour.titheBalanceDescription: This card shows how much tithe is still due. A minus means you have already given more than required — you have a credit.
tour.openingBalanceDescription: Coming from another notebook or spreadsheet? Set the current balance once here. TEN10 continues from that number. Use the + on this card.
tour.cardQuickAddDescription: Each + opens a transaction of that type — income, expense, or donation.
tour.continueToFormDescription: Next we'll open the form and walk through the fields — first the everyday ones, then the tithe-specific options.
tour.formIntroDescription: This is where every transaction is recorded. Type, amount, date, and description are enough to save. The options below refine how it affects the tithe.
tour.formImportDescription: Have many rows in Excel or from the bank? Import them here in one go instead of typing each one. You can open import now or later.
tour.formBasicsDescription: Choose the type, enter the amount — any currency — a date, and a short description. Categories help you sort later.
tour.flagsDescription:
These buttons decide how the transaction counts toward the tithe:

  • Income — Exempt skips the tithe. Chomesh takes 20% instead of 10%.
  • Expense — mark whether the money already came from the maaser or chomesh fund.
  • The side balance updates accordingly after you save.
tour.recurringDescription: This adds a standing order to the Standing orders table, and TEN10 creates the transaction automatically on the day you chose — every month.
tour.liveBalanceTitle: The balance updates after you save
tour.liveBalanceDescription: After you save the transaction, the cards on the side update — including the tithe balance.

success.title: You're in
success.description: Your first transaction is saved. The monthly chart below Home shows the trend, and Contact is there if you need a rabbi or technical help.

checklist.title: Getting started
checklist.description: Two small steps to see TEN10 at work.

pageTour.ariaLabel: Start a tour of this page

importTour.introDescription: Import many transactions from a CSV or Excel file. The flow has four stages, and only the rows you approve at the end are added to the table.
importTour.stepsDescription: Prepare, upload a file, map columns, then review and approve. You can go back at any stage. Nothing is saved before the final confirmation.
importTour.checklistDescription: Upload a file, map the columns, review the rows — and only then approve. Nothing is saved before the final confirmation.
importTour.templateDescription: Download the TEN10 template to skip most column mapping. You can also upload your own file.
importTour.uploadDescription: Drop a CSV or Excel file here, or click to choose one. After the file is read, you map the columns.
importTour.mappingDescription: Next you match each column in the file to a TEN10 field: type, amount, date, and description. The TEN10 template fills most of this in for you.
importTour.reviewDescription: You see a preview of every row, fix errors, and choose what to import. Possible duplicates or standing-order matches are flagged first.
importTour.approveDescription: Only after you approve are the transactions added to the table. Until then you can go back, fix rows, or cancel — nothing is saved.
